import sys

def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if not args:
        print("sayı yok")
        return
    numbers = list(map(float, args))
    average = sum(numbers) / len(numbers)
    print(f"{average:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

sayilar = list(map(int, sys.argv[1:]))

if not sayilar:
    print('sayı yok')
else:
    ortalama = sum(sayilar) / len(sayilar)
    print(f"{ortalama:.2f}")

import sys

def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if not args:
        print("sayı yok")
        return
    numbers = [float(arg) for arg in args]
    average = sum(numbers) / len(numbers)
    print(f"{average:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
